component.name: Spoff
component.summary: Terminal audio player streaming from YouTube Music with Spotify metadata sync

description.p: Spoff is a fast, low-memory terminal audio player for Linux that streams tracks from YouTube Music while syncing your Spotify libraries and playlists without requiring Spotify Premium.

ul.li: Zero Spotify Premium requirement — audio streams cleanly via background mpv playback.
Extremely lightweight — idles under 50MB RAM compared to heavy Electron desktop apps.
Automatic local audio caching for instant offline playback.
Real-time 60 FPS PCM audio spectrum visualizer via CAVA.
Interactive synchronized LRC lyrics with click-to-seek timestamp navigation.
Full Vim keybindings (hjkl) and intuitive keyboard navigation.
Native D-Bus MPRIS 2 integration with Waybar, lockscreens, and hardware media keys.

screenshot.caption: Browsing tracks and playlists in Spoff TUI

description.p: Initial release of spoff: terminal music streaming, Spotify sync, CAVA visualizer, and MPRIS 2 controls.
